info.title: UponAI Public API
info.description: Customer API for agents, conversations, calls, knowledge, and voices. Authenticate with a dashboard-generated bearer token and use GET /api/v1/workspaces to discover accessible workspaces.

200.description: Workspaces visible to the authenticated token.

post.description: Initiate a PSTN phone call via UponAI infrastructure. The workspace is inferred from the unique agentId. You may still send workspaceId for backward compatibility. Native-transfer workspaces expose the full per-call override surface, including agentOverride, overrideAgentVersion, customSipHeaders, and ignoreE164Validation.

get.description: Deprecated. List calls with optional workspace, agent, status, and date filters from local call history. Use POST /api/v1/calls/list for the current cursor-compatible listing contract.

post.description: List calls from local call history with the current unified pagination envelope. The response returns `items`, `has_more`, and `pagination_key`; send the returned pagination key in the next request to continue. You may include workspaceId to scope the query to one accessible workspace.

get.description: Return paginated call history for a single workspace, including agent and workspace metadata plus optional search and date filters.

calls.summary: Customer confirmed an appointment for Friday.

get.description: Retrieve details for a specific call.

patch.description: Update stored metadata or opt out of sensitive data storage. The API infers workspace from stored call data when available; workspaceId remains an optional backward-compatible fallback.

post.description: Immediately ends an active voice or web call. If the call is already stored in call history, the workspace is inferred from that record; otherwise provide workspaceId in the request body so the action can be scoped to the correct workspace.

409.description: The call is no longer live.

patch.description: Applies runtime changes to an active call. You can override dynamic variables, metadata, and data storage setting, inject additional context, request a fresh agent response, and start or stop a listen-only audio stream while the call is in progress. These changes take effect immediately; metadata and data storage setting changes are also persisted to the call record. CamelCase and snake_case request field names are both accepted.

409.description: The call is no longer live.

put.description: Reprocess post-call analysis for a completed call. If the call is already stored in call history, the workspace is inferred from that record; otherwise provide workspaceId in the request body.

201.description: Call analysis rerun started or completed.

CreatePhoneCallRequest.description: Unknown top-level fields return HTTP 400 before a call is created. Supply dynamic variables using the documented field, with string values only.

agentId.description: Unique agent identifier. The owning workspace is inferred from this value.

workspaceId.description: Optional backward-compatible workspace hint. If supplied, it must match the workspace that owns agentId.

fromNumber.description: Caller identifier. For native-transfer workspaces this may be an imported number, extension, or platform-side pseudo DID when ignoreE164Validation is enabled.

toNumber.description: Destination identifier to dial. Standard phone calls should use E.164; native-transfer workspaces can also use configured extensions or pseudo numbers when ignoreE164Validation is enabled.

overrideCid.description: Optional SIP From display-name override. The selected fromNumber remains the actual caller ID/user part for native-transfer calls.

callerIdFormat.description: Native-transfer only. Format applied to the caller ID before the outbound leg is dialed.

toNumberFormat.description: Native-transfer only. Format applied to the destination number before the outbound leg is dialed.

overrideAgentVersion.description: Native-transfer only. Overrides the agent version for this specific call.

customFromNumber.description: Optional custom caller identifier used when fromNumber is set to custom. This may be a configured non-E.164 identifier on supported trunk-based workspaces.

customStatusHookUrl.description: Per-call destination for branded call_started, call_ended, and call_analyzed events.

customSipHeaders.description: Native-transfer only. Additional SIP headers merged into the outbound call request.

ignoreE164Validation.description: Native-transfer only. Disables E.164 validation so imported pseudo DIDs, extensions, and other custom telephony identifiers can be used. The platform may also enable this automatically when needed on supported workspaces.

uponai_dynamic_variables.description: Dynamic variables with string values only (including empty strings). CamelCase variable containers are not supported.

workspaceId.description: Optional backward-compatible workspace hint. If supplied, it must match the workspace that owns agentId.

agentId.description: Unique agent identifier. The owning workspace is inferred from this value.

workspaceId.description: Optional branded extension to scope results to one accessible workspace.

limit.description: Maximum number of calls to return.

skip.description: Number of records to skip for pagination.

pagination_key.description: Pagination key from the previous response.

include_total.description: Whether to include the total count of matching calls.

CallFilter.description: Filter criteria for calls. All provided conditions are combined with AND.

agent.description: Agent filters are combined with OR.

op.description: Equal, not equal, starts with, ends with, or contains.

pagination_key.description: Pagination key for the next page, or null when no more results are available.

total.description: Total number of matching calls. Present only when include_total is true.

start_timestamp.description: Start timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

end_timestamp.description: End timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

workspaceId.description: Optional backward-compatible fallback. Required only when the call cannot be resolved from stored call data.
Optional backward-compatible fallback. Required only when the call cannot be resolved from stored call data.

dynamicVariables.description: Delta of dynamic variable overrides. Set to null to remove existing overrides.

metadata.description: Metadata persisted to the call record. Maximum size is 50KB.

dataStorageSetting.description: Data storage setting for this call. More restrictive settings may not be relaxed during a live call.

triggerResponse.description: When true, requests that the live agent generate a response when appropriate. If the agent is speaking, the current response may be interrupted depending on the agent interruption settings. If the user is speaking, the request is ignored so the agent does not talk over them.

additionalContext.description: Non-empty text injected into the live call context for the next agent response.

action.description: Start or stop a listen-only audio stream for the live call.

url.description: WebSocket URL that will receive the live call audio stream. Required when action is start.

mixType.description: Audio channel mix for the stream.

metadata.description: Optional metadata delivered with the stream setup.
